name: io.gamedock.sdk.ads.admob.AdMobAdActivity
description: When Gamedock (Azerion) starts an AdMob interstitial or rewarded video, this Activity provides the full-screen loading and cancel screen and runs the selected ad flow.
disableEffect: Blocking it stops Gamedock AdMob full-screen ads; users will not receive rewards for rewarded videos handled by this flow.
